title: Learn Anything Faster with the S.M.A.R.T. Learning Framework
description:
1-Page PDF Summary: https://lozeron-academy-llc.kit.com/smart-learning
Productivity Game Academy (includes a 2-week accelerated learning guide): https://tinyurl.com/academyPG

Whether you want to quickly sound knowledgeable at work, ace an exam, or level up a new skill like pickleball, you can do it surprisingly quickly by focusing on five meta-learning skills from the best learning science books.

🔑 The SMART Framework:
1. State Optimization: Learn how to intensely focus before you even start studying. We’ll show you the 15-30 minute trick that floods your brain with focus-enhancing neurochemicals, backed by research in Spark and Deep Work.

2. Mistake Optimization: Discover the "sweet spot" for mistakes: the 85/15 rule. Learn how failing 15% of the time keeps your brain primed for maximum growth, and how to use AI to design perfect practice drills.

3. Active Recall: Stop just reviewing notes! Learn why effort = retention. We'll share three simple habits (Periodic Pause, End-of-session recap, and Start-of-session recall) from Make It Stick that force your brain to build strong neural pathways.

4. Reduction: Complexity fades, simplicity endures. Master the art of reducing everything you learn into one thing: an Acronym, a Sentence, a Page, or a Visual. (Inspired by books like Atomic Habits).

5. Turning Off: The most critical step. Learn why masters prioritize sleep (1.5 hours more than average!) and how naps can boost recall by 20%. True learning and consolidation happen when you rest, as detailed in Why We Sleep and Peak.

Stop studying harder and start studying SMART! Tap the link to subscribe for more science-backed productivity hacks!

Peak: Secrets from the New Science of Expertise
